text: Multiple fee clauses plus renewal, notice, and utility terms.

pages.text: Application fee is $25. Processing fee is $30. Parking fee is $50 per month. Pet fee is $200. Cleaning fee is $150. Automatic renewal applies for another term unless Tenant gives written notice at least 60 days before expiration. Utilities may be allocated by management.
